item.title: Press Release: Closure of Kingston Wharf
item.description: The Maritime Administration Department (MARAD) wishes to advise that the Kingston Wharf Facility will be closed from 00:00hrs on Sunday, February 15, 2026, to 00:00hrs on Saturday, February 21, 2026.
